title: Apply for a National Police Check
summary: You can apply online for a National Police Check from the NSW Police Force.
intro: You can apply online for a National Police Check from the NSW Police Force. This check may be required for any of the following:
who_can_apply: Must be 14 years old or over when applying.
Must be a permanent resident of NSW.
If living outside NSW, you can apply in your state or territory.
what_you_need: An email account to receive your verification code.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for your police check.

more_info.text: If you need a name, date of birth and fingerprint check as part of your application, you'll receive a letter by email advising you to attend your local police station to have your fingerprints taken.

If you need a criminal record check for Australian citizenship, residency, spouse visa, guardianship of a child from another country, working visa, or while travelling or living abroad, you can apply online via the Australian Federal Police website.
